items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I'd always work with some guys with maybe two or three pieces like Ryan Young and Frank's Quarter when the big band wasn't doing nothing.

ctx.x: I was staying on La Hop, La Hop and La Prusse, I believe it was, and Randy was staying right across the street from me. So, well like I said, at that time in working with the big band, I'd always work with some guys with maybe two or three pieces like Ryan Young and Frank's Quarter when the big band wasn't doing nothing. And I was doing a little range in that time for the band. Yeah. So when the word got around and Sidney had let me go, well, I remember Leo Dazio came to my house because he had one of the guys…
